exposure: Uterine Artery Embolization (UAE) for symptomatic fibroids
outcome: obstetric complications (including miscarriage rate, type of delivery)
cohort: The study included women aged 18-45 years who were treated by Uterine Artery Embolization (UAE) for symptomatic fibroids and subsequently attempted pregnancy.
finding: Fertility may be preserved in a subset of women undergoing UAE for symptomatic fibroids, particularly those with complex surgical histories or high-risk surgical profiles.
mod_finding: All live births in the study cohort were delivered via cesarean section.
